results.title: Barrister highlights ‘incredible delay’ on anniversary of Manchester City hearing
results.description: Leading sports barrister Nick De Marco has highlighted the “most incredible delay” in reaching an outcome in the key Manchester City legal case.

results.title: Can Bills tame Lions in new Highmark opener?
results.description: The Buffalo Bills head home to host the Detroit Lions in their first regular-season game at the new $2.2 billion Highmark Stadium.

results.title: Formula 1 returns to Portugal in 2027
results.description: The Formula 1 Portuguese Grand Prix will be held on 20 June, being the ninth race of the 2027 World Championship, according to the announced calendar.
